departures_exactly_one_parent.name: departures_exactly_one_parent
departures_exactly_one_parent.value: ("departures"."tour_id" is not null)::int + ("departures"."motorcycle_tour_id" is not null)::int = 1

bookings_product_matches_kind.name: bookings_product_matches_kind
bookings_product_matches_kind.value:
case "bookings"."kind"
            when 'tour'  then "bookings"."tour_id" is not null
            when 'moto'  then "bookings"."motorcycle_tour_id" is not null
            when 'stay'  then "bookings"."homestay_id" is not null
            when 'event' then "bookings"."event_id" is not null
          end
